templates.name: Gym Floor Rules
templates.description: Five house rules for the training floor.

elements.text: Spray and wipe every bench and machine after use.
Plates and dumbbells back on the rack, every time.
Twenty minutes max on cardio when the floor is busy.
Keep walkways and racks clear of bags and coats.
Staff in red shirts are happy to spot or advise.
Thanks for keeping the floor safe for everyone
